summary: Backend testing complete for Garlic by Urban Nest. All 20 pytest cases passed (100% success). Covered health, categories (7), products list/filter/detail/404, auth signup+duplicate+login by email/mobile+wrong-password+/me, admin RBAC, admin CRUD (create→GET→update→GET→delete→404), wishlist toggle+get, and orders (create with mock=true, list, get, other-user 404, hosted checkout HTML, mock-pay, status persistence). Verified no MongoDB `_id` field leaks in any response (recursive check). Razorpay is in expected MOCK mode (keys empty in /app/backend/.env) and mock-pay works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Return HTTP 200 on successful create instead of 201. Not a functional bug, but not fully REST-idiomatic.
When another user requests, endpoint returns 404 (owner-scoped find). Acceptable pattern (avoids resource enumeration) but 403 would be more explicit. Documented, not blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: return 201 for POST /api/products to align with REST conventions.
Optional: Consider explicit 403 (instead of 404) when a non-owner user hits /api/orders/{id} — current behavior is acceptable and even preferred for privacy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~537 lines — still within the 700-line guideline but approaching it. Consider splitting into routers/ (auth, products, wishlist, orders, payments) before it grows further.
Good: Mongo `_id` is projected out consistently ({'_id': 0}) and password_hash is stripped from user responses.
Good: JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL, ADMIN_PASSWORD sourced from env; no hardcoded secrets.
Good: Async motor client used correctly; bcrypt+pyjwt used for auth; Razorpay init is guarded against empty keys.
Minor: `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')` is deprecated in newer FastAPI — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users (TEST_/random) and one TEST_Admin_Product which is deleted within the same test. A few orders remain in DB tied to test users — acceptable for a preview environment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_garlic_backend.py as regression suite. It uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Razorpay is intentionally in MOCK mode; do not set live keys. If Razorpay keys are added in future, add signature-verify tests via /api/payments/verify.
